approval_ref: The active goal requires an auditable advanced-model reference implementation while CIRP locally manages exact task, input, result, citation and review identity.
notes: Create one safe immutable input receipt for every settled QA V3 model decision, including call and request identity, prompt-contract hash, hashed evidence inputs, hashed images and byte counts.
Persist receipts with publishable Reference results and with evaluation contract failures without retaining source text, prompt content, rejected provider output or private reasoning.
Keep historical Reference results and failures readable with no receipt; do not rewrite them or claim that a stronger-model benchmark has run.
Render receipts as collapsed audit metadata in the Reference workspace and include them in the existing bounded JSON export.
Use only synthetic MockTransport validation and make no external provider call.
title: Persist safe Reference model-input execution receipts
objective: Make every settled Reference model decision independently auditable from safe hashes and sizes while preserving exact results or safe failures without storing the model input text twice.
